decisions.notes: Could not confirm whether Draft/Urgency Ordinance No. 819 (the 45-day data center moratorium) was actually adopted at its scheduled 2026-05-27 public hearing. Checked: (1) the CivicClerk event record for that meeting, which has an agenda and an agenda-materials packet but no minutes file at all (minutesFile is null), so there is no record of the roll-call vote; (2) the Municode 'Ordinance List and Disposition Table' for Irwindale, which is stale and stops at Ordinance 621, well short of 819; (3) regional news coverage (LA Daily News, sgvtribune via that article) of Irwindale's subsequent permanent ban (Ordinance 821, adopted 2026-09-09), none of which mentions Ordinance 819's fate; (4) a general bc-web search for 'Irwindale Ordinance 819 adopted', which surfaced only the agenda item and unrelated same-numbered ordinances from other cities. This matches the original researcher's own conclusion of 'unconfirmed.' Regardless of 819's disposition, the row's enacted_status=replaced is independently supported by the confirmed adoption of the permanent Ordinance 821 (2026-09-09, effective 2026-10-09), so I am leaving the row's status unchanged. Not a REMOVE: even if 819 was never formally voted on, the City clearly treated a data-center pause as in effect (staff report/legal basis referencing it, subsequent permanent ban), so there is a real underlying instrument story here, just an unconfirmed exact adoption date for the interim measure.
